notes: This portable C++ TCK slice uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs, standard HLAstandardMIM declarations, standard HLAunicodeString/HLAvariableArray encodings, and the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider package, base FOM, standard MIM, additional FOM module, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time configuration when applicable. It checks active ordinary discovery and reflection of HLAmanager.HLAfederate and HLAmanager.HLAfederation, the reflected federate/federation identity values, the predefined HLAfederate and HLAfederation Table 8 P-attribute sets, known-object and class-wide value requests, and the selected region-designator metadata. Through the official API it checks the HLAfederate region dimension and half-open unit bounds [n, n + 1), where n is Normalize Federate Handle(reflected HLAfederateHandle). On selected attribute updates it also checks empty user tags/no timestamped reflection callbacks; resignation removals are checked for empty tags/no timestamped removal callbacks. Region and metadata evidence is limited to the tested paths; it does not cover every periodic/conditional update or every RTI output. It does not assert platform-specific hostname spelling or execution location, filesystem reports, RTI-version values, private snapshots, provider registries, Umbra headers, or an RTI-originated producer handle.
